trigger.diagnostic_finding: Fifteen noncovalent candidates failed only the borrowed whole-domain RMSD ceiling even though their frozen ATP-pocket residue, anchor, ligand-location, and completeness checks passed. Whole-domain conformational variation is desired ensemble information and is not a chain-integrity failure.

scope: Supersede only the alignment and ATP-site/covalent-intent adjudication rules before ligand preparation or any benchmark docking. Retain the 58-candidate metadata pool, mutation and title filters, minimum 240 matched C-alpha atoms, pocket and anchor residue identities, heavy-atom completeness, explicit covalent-connection gate, structural features, target count, and max-min rule.

superseded_rule.reason: This rule penalizes the active/inactive domain motion that a receptor ensemble is intended to represent and can mis-register the ATP pocket in a common docking frame.

replacement_alignment_gate.alignment: proper-rotation Kabsch alignment using the 20 frozen ATP-pocket anchor C-alpha atoms
replacement_alignment_gate.global_ca_rmsd_policy: record for diagnosis but do not use as an exclusion criterion

strengthened_atp_site_gate.reason: Minimum ligand-to-HYZ atom distance alone admitted long allosteric ligands that merely approached one edge of the reference ATP-site ligand.

strengthened_covalent_intent_gate.reason: The first structural gate missed prereaction or non-bond-modeled targeted covalent ligands, including BDTX-1535 and Canertinib, whose primary RCSB citation explicitly identifies the study as targeted covalent inhibitor work.

selection.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by EGFR_2RGP_reference
selection.failure_action: stop without ligand-panel docking if fewer than 16 structures pass the corrected gate

data_boundary.structural_preregistration_status: post-coordinate diagnostic correction; no longer an untouched structural gate

authorization: Re-audit all 58 frozen metadata candidates with local ATP-pocket alignment and the strengthened ATP-site and covalent-intent gates, then run structural max-min selection only.
interpretation_boundary: This correction is post-coordinate and must be reported as such. Because no activity labels, docking scores, train outcomes, validation rows, or test rows were used, downstream EGFR screening remains untouched; passing still establishes only a receptor-preparation candidate pool, not docking validity or any QUBO or quantum claim.
